comment: SITES.md step 6: the Former Premises, the one place in the world you cannot walk to. Flown to, landed on - on Mike's floating island (P2), either cell of the castle row, after which a parallel door asks - walked into and out of, onto whichever cell the airship is on, and asked again only after flying - never $gameMap.event(n).start(), because walking is what proves the door swap landed on the right squares and that the airship rules hold on them. Then the signature page on Grimspite, run through finale_ending's own harness.
